cues.en: Now we have implemented Q using array, and we know that when we are implementing q with array, the
first element is going to be the front of the q, and the last element is going to be the end of the
q.
This means that when we are enqueuing, the element is going to be enqueued at the end, and when we
are dequeuing, it's going to remove the beginning of this array.
Now, when it comes to the implementation in Linkedlist, we have to identify which end is going to
be the beginning of the queue and which end is going to be the end of the queue.
So we have to find out the optimized way to be able to do that.
We have to find the time complexity for inserting and removing at the beginning of the linked list,
and for inserting and removing at the end of the linked list.
So let's look at first to the end.
So when we are removing the element from the end of the linked list, the time complexity is going to
be o n.
And when we are inserting the element at the end of the linked list, the time complexity is going to
be o one.
So take into account that here we are talking about the single linked list.
This means that when we are enqueuing the elements to the queue, we can use the end of the linked list
because the time complexity is going to be o one.
So if you are enqueuing the elements at the end of the linked list, least we have to dequeue the elements
from the beginning of the linked list, because queue works in a first in and first out order.
That's why when we are enqueuing the elements to this end, we have to dequeue the elements from this
end over here, which is going to be the beginning.
So if we look at the time complexity of inserting and removing the elements from the beginning of the
linked list, we will see that for inserting and for removing, the time complexity is going to be o
one.
So this means that for dequeuing the elements from the queue, we can use the beginning of the linked
list like this.
Now in the linked list, we know that we have a head and tail as a pointer, but when it comes to the
queue implementation, we are just going to replace these head and tail pointers to point to the front
and end of the queue.
So the beginning of the linked list is going to be the front of the queue, and end of the linked list
is going to be the end of the queue.
